recomputed:
All 53 SOURCES.tsv paths were unique and accounted for every file in sources/. All 53 sizes and SHA-256 digests matched, totaling 6,375,365 bytes. I parsed 29 JSON and 10 XML documents, decompressed all three gzip streams through their CRC trailers, read both ENA TSVs, and extracted all 47 pages of the preprint PDF through its end marker. The seven HTML files comprise four source or listing pages, one MGI query page and two PubMed challenge receipts. The 227-byte text file is a transcribed supplement inventory. I confirmed its Data S1–S8 listing in the coauthor’s posted version of record. The Europe PMC error XML and the two PubMed challenge pages are access receipts. None supplies an attachment.

The current manual ledger says processed_source_match / manual_structure_match. The verification ledger says not_located / not_tested. The comparability, additional comparison spec, and concordance ledgers have no entry for this dataset. All proposed keys and enum values occur in their corresponding ledgers. The registry identifies arcuate / hepdko_vs_control with control as baseline. Its time-series description names Bmal1/Clock and counts three individual mice per arm and time. The GEO titles, treatment fields, samplesheet, provenance and final Figure 2 instead identify 24 ARC pools from male floxed Nr1d1/Nr1d2 mice, including three Cre and three EGFP libraries at each of ZT4, 10, 16 and 22. The paper describes BMAL1 deletion in a separate experiment. The 24 nodose libraries are outside the registered fit.

The GEO matrix has 25,229 distinct gene labels, 48 distinct GSM-matched library columns, 1,210,992 nonnegative integer cells and zero effect or test columns. Each of 48 GSM records has one supplementary-file field set to NONE. The series lists one count file and the GEO series matrix has zero feature rows. An independent download of the 1,419,547-byte compressed count file matched provenance SHA-256 7afd4ddebf35c883d8a53cfe9f30c2c166abb9e3bc55ba5451a91e394c936040. The samplesheet matched ee0f23a436889e60852cb72f2c668f0961071544452a0d3e461963d9c7852962. The registered DE table matched 92caa970b75bcb5223c0d447e3228e3edfe7a578177011feaa80d2e8dc73b7a9. The feature map preserves all 25,229 input labels one to one. The published table contains 15,365 distinct tested symbols, leaving 9,864 input labels outside that table.

The registered TMM-normalized edgeR quasi-likelihood fit uses an intercept and groupcase, with 12 ARC pools per arm and no time term. Positive log2 fold change means higher expression in HepDKO. I checked finite effects and raw P/FDR throughout the file. Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment over all 15,365 raw P values reproduces the stored FDR within 3.0 × 10⁻¹⁵. Only Mir6236 has FDR < 0.05 (0.018607794605964). ENA lists 48 distinct runs under PRJNA1044072 and no rows in the study-accession analysis query. All 48 BioSample/experiment pairs link to GEO. Only six ENA sample titles are populated.

Figure 2A reports 105 ARC genes and Figure 2E reports 522 nodose genes under the authors’ dryR rule (chosen model 3 or 5, amplitude at least 1.5-fold). Figure 2D shows time-resolved expression and the reported POMC/CART decrease concerns ZT22. Preprint Figure 2D specifies one ARC pool per group and time, and final Figure 2B specifies three. These observations supply no paired effect for the registered pooled coefficient. Author identifiers for this contrast, its tested universe, signed effects, P/FDR and coverage remain unassessed. Neither author-concordance-v2 route can be evaluated. No gene subset, sign flip or threshold was introduced to compare the local discovery count with the paper.

Live checks of logged routes reproduced HTTP 403 at https://www.science.org/doi/suppl/10.1126/science.adn2786 and its candidate supplement PDF URL. Both named PMC attachment URLs returned HTTP 200 with reCAPTCHA HTML. The Europe PMC supplementaryFiles export for PMC11629121 with includeInlineImage=false returned a 297-byte XML eligibility error on retry, with SHA-256 dee40af4d17ff0eb716d870877879ce220995e261edbac95e345c51b001ac57c. Two routes outside the original log also yielded no comparable table. https://www.omicsdi.org/ws/dataset/geo/GSE248462 links to the same GEO directory. https://www.informatics.jax.org/reference/json?id=39509517&results=25&startIndex=0 resolves J:363115 and lists three genome features, three phenotypic alleles and two strains. The coauthor’s copy confirms the supplement inventory at https://www.researchgate.net/publication/385656083_Hepatic_vagal_afferents_convey_clock-dependent_signals_to_regulate_circadian_food_intake. Access to the final data attachments remains blocked on the routes checked. Whether a comparable table exists inside them is unknown.

refute/verify.py independently reproduced all five computed entries. I also reran audit.py with its write to audit.json intercepted and compared the in-memory result with the saved JSON. All 35 fields agreed.
problems: SOURCES.tsv describes mgi.html as a publication record. Its bytes contain a reference-query page with an empty results container. The live JSON query supplied the actual bibliography and curation categories. The OpenAIRE query also searched for a dataset bearing the article’s own DOI, which leaves datasets with different DOIs outside that search.

The individual GEO protocols specify three mice per ARC pool. Three falls within the series and paper’s range of three to four. Exact pool membership remains undocumented. All 24 ARC growth protocols specify 27 °C, while the manuscript’s general animal methods give 20–22 °C. The records do not reconcile the housing temperature for this cohort.

The proposed ledger reason omits why manual review is required. The repository evaluator gives review_required precedence and displays an unresolved outcome, even with a ledger input of not_tested. The correction names the registry metadata error in the reason and next step and makes clear that pooled author agreement remains untested.

The search log labels the individual Science filenames as candidates, but the proposed ledger text loses that qualification. HTTP 403 establishes an access barrier on the routes tried. The final paper establishes the Data S1–S8 inventory. Neither establishes the filenames, formats or biological contrasts in those data.
